description: Golden evaluation set for the LLM advisory pipeline. Never export to Dataset/*.csv and never attach training labels.

cases.source: Enhancement 4 stress case; expectations pinned to this repo's EthioSIS/EIAR bands and zone overrides
cases.rationale: Strongly acidic Nitisol. The repo pins pH 5.5-6.5 and the LRF yields 2.94 t/ha lime (not the paste's 4-5 t/ha); applied P is scaled by the 0.4 fixation factor.

cases.source: Enhancement 4 stress case; expectations pinned to this repo's EthioSIS/EIAR bands and zone overrides
cases.rationale: Rift Valley K band is 400-900 kg/ha, so 950 (not the paste's 850) is the ample case. pH 7.8 crosses the 7.5 Zn/B lockout threshold, so the P advice must switch to NPSZnB and K must not get a maintenance dose.

cases.source: Enhancement 4 stress case; expectations pinned to this repo's EthioSIS/EIAR bands and zone overrides
cases.rationale: Generic N band is 60-100 kg/ha, so 125 is ample in this repo (the paste assumed 'adequate'). The safety property under test is that no cereal-booster nitrogen is prescribed.

cases.source: Enhancement 4 stress case; expectations pinned to this repo's EthioSIS/EIAR bands and zone overrides
cases.rationale: Vertisol N band is 150-300 kg/ha, so N=80 is deficient and the engine currently recommends urea. The repo has no legume / nodulation template yet; this case records the gap without gating on advisory text that does not exist.

cases.source: Enhancement 4 stress case; expectations pinned to this repo's EthioSIS/EIAR bands and zone overrides
cases.rationale: pH 8.4 is above the Rift Valley 7.5 threshold; the P advice must name the NPSZnB blend rather than plain NPS/DAP.
